name: Malik
source: A librarian. He says that he and Neyris were good friends when they were children, but Neyris doesn't remember him at all. Malik is an extremely timid and quiet boy with no friends. He always wears a hat and too-long bangs so that nobody can see the upper part of his face. He feels more secure this way.
